QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] The Implacable Maid
QuestInfo.0: You tried to talk to the princess, but were stopped by a little old bossy maid. Convince Parma to let you through.
QuestInfo.1: Parma insists on proof that she can trust you. Defeat the #bCorrupted Intermediate Magicians#k at the #bCorrupted Magic Forest 2#k.
QuestInfo.2: You completed the mission that Parma requested. She'd better let you through now!
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0#  127,022,299
Can proceed to [Kritias] The Irrepressible Maid

0.0: Hold it RIGHT there! Her Highness is extremely exhausted. If you MUST speak to her, you'll have to make an official request for an audience.\r\n#L0##bI hereby make an official request for an audience.#l\n#k
0.1: Not so fast! First, you must pass a rigorous screening process, wherein I will test your worthiness, uprightness, and nobility. IF you pass, THEN I shall entertain your request to see the princess.\r\n#L0##bAll right. I guess I'll practice my curtsy...#l\n#k
0.2: The first test of nobility will send you into the Corrupted Magic Forest to fight evil magicians. Are you prepared to show off your skills as a noble?

yes.0: Off you go to #bCorrupted Magic Forest 2#k. Eliminate the Corrupted Intermediate Magicians, and we might be able to secure the external supply route again. Eliminate #b100 Corrupted Intermediate Magicians#k.
yes.1: A trail through the #bForest of Laments 2#k northeast of town leads to Corrupted Magic Forest 2. Take the portal north of the marketplace and turn right. And do try not to get lost.

no.0: I'll have you know that the ability to punch magicians is paramount to being a good noble! Who are you going to believe, your brain or a maid?

yes.0: Phew, I can see a glimmer of hope now but... What should I do?

item.0: Eliminate the Corrupted Intermediate Magicians in #bCorrupted Magic Forest 2#k.
